name: atom-ui-colors
description: Add Atom Material colors to supported VS Code UI icons. Keep their shapes, sizes and your file icon theme.

commands.title: Atom UI Colors: Apply / Repair Colors
Atom UI Colors: Restore Previous Appearance
Atom UI Colors: Open Generated CSS Folder

atomUIColors.enabled.description: Apply the colors automatically. Turning this off restores this extension's changes.

atomUIColors.activityBarContrast.description: Improve automatic activity bar icon colors to reach 3:1 contrast against verified theme backgrounds. Use the theme foreground when the background cannot be verified. Explicit icon color overrides are preserved.

atomUIColors.statusBarContrast.description: Improve automatic status bar icon colors, including the notification bell, to reach 3:1 contrast against verified backgrounds. Use the item's native foreground for unknown backgrounds and special status entries. Explicit icon color overrides are preserved.

atomUIColors.colors.description: Optional icon ID to #RRGGBB overrides, for example {"search": "#80CBC4"}.

atomUIColors.viewColors.description: Optional extension view ID to #RRGGBB colors for SVG mask icons.
